content.short: Link-In-Bio creator profiles with Cardano Stickers to fund your creative journey & build a community of true fans.
content.description: Creatious supports creators by providing an easy way to sell Cardano Stickers along their entire journey. Stickers work like a web3 tip-jar with superpowers. Fans support their creators by collecting a sticker and may get various rewards in return. Stickers are made of an original image that can be minted unlimitedly - or until the creator decides to pause or replace a Sticker - and has all the same technical benefits of NFTs, without the problems that scarcity brings.
content.meta: Find out about Creatious (STICKERS) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
